test_framework: jest@27 + custom SFC transformer (script + compiled template) + jsdom (synthetic)
notes: Synthetic behavioral tests. The component is truly mounted together with the real CustomizeableTooltip (templates compiled by the custom transformer via vue-template-compiler, already in node_modules); the game tick is driven by calling vm.update() as GameUI does, hovering goes through the component's own mousemove handler, and assertions read only rendered output. f2p: all four milestone-derived surfaces must track their untracked sources across ticks - the tooltip's description line, its resource line, its own highlight, and the markers along the bar (the last one flips a milestone the pointer is NOT on, so a fix that refreshes only the hovered milestone still fails). All four are frozen on base b07bff4e. p2p: the description renders, the percentage readout renders, the tooltip follows a newly hovered milestone without waiting for a tick (passes on base - guards against a tick-only cache), and the tooltip element survives across ticks rather than being rebuilt (guards against forcing refreshes by re-keying and tearing the tooltip down).
